pages.html:
🌱 Green Wheels

Green Wheels Vegan Food Truck

Plant-based comfort food, served fresh from our truck. Delicious vegan meals, zero compromise on taste.

Explore Our Menu

Our Vegan Menu

All meals are 100% vegan, made with fresh, locally-sourced ingredients whenever possible.

Appetizers & Starters

Crispy Chickpea Fritters
Golden-fried chickpea patties with tahini dipping sauce
$6.50
Loaded Nachos
Tortilla chips, cashew cheese, black beans, jalapeños, cilantro crema
$8.00
Crispy Spring Rolls
Vegetable spring rolls with peanut sauce and sriracha aioli
$5.50
Hummus & Veggie Plate
Roasted red pepper hummus with fresh carrots, cucumbers, and pita
$7.00

Sandwiches & Wraps

Crispy Tofu Po'Boy
Fried tofu, shredded cabbage, pickles, vegan remoulade on a soft roll
$11.00
Spicy Black Bean Burger
House-made patty with avocado, lettuce, tomato, chipotle mayo, brioche bun
$12.00
Mediterranean Wrap
Hummus, roasted vegetables, spinach, olives, vegan feta in a spinach tortilla
$10.50
Buffalo Cauliflower Sandwich
Crispy cauliflower tossed in buffalo sauce, coleslaw, vegan ranch dressing
$11.50

Main Bowls

Buddha Power Bowl
Quinoa, roasted sweet potato, chickpeas, kale, avocado, tahini dressing
$12.50
Thai Peanut Noodle Bowl
Rice noodles, crispy tofu, broccoli, carrots, cashews, creamy peanut sauce
$13.00
Burrito Bowl
Brown rice, black beans, corn, peppers, onions, cilantro lime rice, salsa, guacamole
$12.00
Korean BBQ Mushroom Bowl
Sesame rice, marinated mushrooms, steamed broccoli, carrots, kimchi, gochujang mayo
$13.50

Sides

Sweet Potato Fries
Crispy golden fries with garlic aioli
$4.50
Truffle Parmesan Fries
Fries with truffle oil and nutritional yeast
$5.00
Steamed Broccoli
Fresh broccoli with lemon and garlic
$3.50
Roasted Vegetables
Seasonal vegetables with herbs
$4.00

Desserts

Vegan Brownie
Rich chocolate brownie with walnuts
$4.00
Banana Nice Cream
Soft-serve coconut ice cream with berries
$5.00
Chocolate Chip Cookie
Warm, chewy cookie with dairy-free chocolate chips
$3.50
Mango Sorbet
Refreshing frozen mango puree
$4.50

Beverages

Fresh Lemonade
Freshly squeezed with mint
$3.50
Iced Herbal Tea
Choice of flavors: berry, peach, or hibiscus
$3.00
Smoothie Bowl
Almond butter, banana, berries with granola and coconut
$6.50
Oat Milk Latte
Espresso with steamed oat milk
$4.50
